note: Re-judged 2026-11-10 independently of producer authors. RFC 4303 Section 3.4.4.1 step 3 says the receiver SHOULD inspect default Padding before removal and delivery. xfrmStateFromParams builds SA selectors, replay, transforms, UDP encapsulation and PMTU/DSCP flags but requests no padding inspection. vppBackend.InstallSA builds the SAD request and vppSAFlags selects direction, tunnel, replay and UDP flags; neither requests padding-byte inspection. Ze performs no ESP decryption at these boundaries. No observed lower-layer proof establishes inspection, so the existing explicit gap remains unimplemented; no support claim is upgraded.
